# Project B Plan Materials

1. The **Project B Plan template**, is available as part of [the 431-data site](https://github.com/LyonsZhang/PQHS431-data/). It is called `431-projectB-plan-template.qmd`. 

# Project B Portfolio Report Materials

2. The **Project B Portfolio Report template** is also available as part of [the 431-data site](https://github.com/LyonsZhang/PQHS431-data/). It is called `431-projectB-portfolio-report-template.qmd`. 

:::{.callout-note}

The Template for the Portfolio Report is identical to the Template for the Project B Plan except that it:

- deletes the old section 13, and 
- adds in headings for the new sections 13-16, while 
- moving the session information from section 14 to section 17.

:::
